an5.250:1.3: yasmiṃ bhikkhave puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti so tathārūpaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā saṃgho ukkhipati
an5.250:1.5: yo kho myāyaṃ puggalo piyo manāpo so saṃghena ukkhittoti
an5.250:1.7: bhikkhūsu appasādabahulo samāno aññe bhikkhū na bhajati
an5.250:1.8: aññe bhikkhū abhajanto saddhammaṃ na suṇāti
an5.250:2.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti so tathārūpaṃ āpattiṃ āpanno hoti yathārūpāya āpattiyā saṃgho ante nisīdāpeti
an5.250:2.3: yo kho myāyaṃ puggalo piyo manāpo so saṃghena ante nisīdāpitoti
an5.250:2.5: bhikkhūsu appasādabahulo samāno aññe bhikkhū na bhajati
an5.250:2.6: aññe bhikkhū abhajanto saddhammaṃ na suṇāti
an5.250:3.1: puna caparaṃ bhikkhave yasmiṃ puggale puggalo abhippasanno hoti so disāpakkanto hoti …pe… so vibbhanto hoti …pe… so kālakato hoti
an5.250:3.3: yo kho myāyaṃ puggalo piyo manāpo so kālakatoti
an5.250:3.5: aññe bhikkhū abhajanto saddhammaṃ na suṇāti
an5.250:3.8: ime kho bhikkhave pañca ādīnavā puggalappasādeti.
